newsitem.title: UK: Hambros prices Haven Funding 2037 bond increase.
newsitem.headline: Hambros prices Haven Funding 2037 bond increase.

text.p: Hambros Bank has priced the 25 million stg tranche launched earlier, that is fungible with the Haven Funding 82.5 million stg bond due September 2037.
The new tranche has been bought by Hambros Bank and the proceeds will be onlent by Haven to Metropolitan Housing Trust Ltd.
